card.name: Inside long medical word stems
card.fires_on: Responds to a middle piece of a long medical or technical word that is still unfinished, such as the 'iaz' in chlordiazepoxide or the 'ialis' in brachioradialis. It also fires on pieces of words like implantation and plyometrics.

modes.label: Chlordiazepoxide and diazepam
modes.description: The middle piece of benzodiazepine names such as chlordiazepoxide and diazepam.

modes.label: Muscle names
modes.description: The ending piece of brachioradialis in botulinum dosing tables.
modes.example: Biceps Brachii 60 Units to 200 Units divided in 2 to 4 sites Brachiorad<<ialis>> 45 Units to 75

modes.label: Other long words
modes.description: Partway through other long clinical or fitness terms like implantation, plyometrics and fibrates.
